items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Bumps Meyers (PHONETIC) was tenor saxophone player

ctx.x: Who else was in your band?

Oh, let's see, well, the -- I'm trying to think who was playing in the band. I know the -- let's see, Bumps Meyers (PHONETIC) was tenor saxophone player and a boy around here was the baritone saxophone player. He passed away; I can't think of his name. Marvin Johnson was playing alto and I can't think who the other -- Andy Anderson was playing tenor and my brother was playing lead trumpet and playing all the high notes. Had another boy by the name of Jack Trainer (PHONETIC) and -- God, it's hard to remember all…
